entries.0391d63b79af0f13: This business brokers the buying and selling of real estate, acts as agent for sales, and purchases properties to resell them. It also manages and operates rental housing and student housing. Brokerage and similar services are provided by Tokyu Livable, Inc. Management, operation and sublease of rental housing and student housing are carried out by Tokyu Housing Lease Co., Ltd., Gakusei Joho Center Co., Ltd. and others. Tokyu Livable, Inc. also acts as entrusted sales agent for condominiums and detached houses sold by Tokyu Corporation, which is an other related company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥356,804 million (¥343,704 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the second largest of the four reportable segments. The number of brokerage transactions for buying and selling increased to 33,922 (32,918 in the previous year). Together with the recording of more development projects in real estate sales, revenue increased. The number of managed rental housing units was 151 thousand at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026.

entries.04c463a874f3447e: This business develops office buildings and commercial facilities for lease or sale, and also develops, sells and sells off condominiums for sale and rental housing. Tokyu Land Corporation and others carry out this business. Some office buildings are entrusted for management and operation to Tokyu Community Corp., and some commercial facilities are entrusted to Tokyu Land SC Management Corporation. Major facilities include Shibuya Sakura Stage and Shibuya Fukuras in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Condominiums for sale are developed and sold under the "BRANZ" brand, mainly in the Greater Tokyo and Kansai areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥397,351 million (¥346,118 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the largest of the four reportable segments. Leasing of offices improved, mainly in the Shibuya area, and the vacancy rate for office buildings and commercial facilities at the end of March 2026 was 0.7%. The number of condominium units recorded decreased to 899 units (1,006 units in the previous year). However, housing revenue increased due to a rise in sales to investors and others, and the business as a whole increased revenue.

entries.67eed0cc50e46a81: As the source of its strengths, the company cites the 'wide range of customer and market touchpoints' and the 'unique business creation capability' of its group companies, and states that it will deepen a business ecosystem in which these two elements create synergies. Combining its strength in environmental leadership with social issues such as building a sustainable, locally circulating society and creating safe and secure communities, the company calls the high added value generated 'Environmental Premium' and is working to create it.

entries.6fda57b2ad7a998d: Consolidated revenue (operating revenue) for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1.246 trillion (¥1,246,048 million), up 8.3% from ¥1,150,301 million in the prior year, marking five consecutive years of revenue growth. The reasons were strong sales to investors and brokerage business against the backdrop of a firm real estate trading market, and improved occupancy of offices and commercial facilities, centered on properties in the greater Shibuya area. Revenue from external customers was ¥397,351 million for the Urban Development Business (¥346,118 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), ¥356,804 million for the Real Estate Distribution Business (¥343,704 million in the same period), ¥350,587 million for the Management and Operations Business (¥351,524 million in the same period), and ¥141,303 million for the Strategic Investment Business (¥108,952 million in the same period).
entries.70cd1d3ecff0f213: Toward the 'future where everyone can live as themselves and shine with vitality' envisioned in the long-term vision 'GROUP VISION 2030,' the company has been pursuing the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2030' since fiscal 2025. Centered on creating premium value that responds to social themes, the company aims to build a robust and distinctive business portfolio that combines growth potential with resilience to market fluctuations. There are 3 priority themes: 'Promotion of the Wide-Area Shibuya Area Strategy,' 'Establishment of a GX Business Model,' and 'Expansion of Glocal Business.' Because the external environment changed significantly after the plan was announced, the company plans to update the Medium-Term Management Plan and publish the update in 2027.

entries.91086fa71b8a6b82: This [[term:holding-company|holding company]] was established on October 1, 2013, through a joint share transfer as the wholly owning parent of Tokyu Fudosan, Tokyu Community, and Tokyu Livable. The group consists of the company, 355 subsidiaries (of which 321 are [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]]) and 112 affiliates, and is divided into four [[term:segment|reportable segments]]: the Urban Development and Strategic Investment businesses under “asset-utilization business,” and the Management and Operations and Real Estate Distribution businesses under “talent-driven business.” Three subsidiaries account for more than 10% of consolidated revenue; their revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥483,910 million for Tokyu Fudosan, ¥189,720 million for Tokyu Community, and ¥254,224 million for Tokyu Livable. The consolidated workforce as of March 31, 2026 was 21,036 (the annual average of 6,746 temporary employees is not included in this figure). TOKYU CORPORATION, which operates transportation, real estate and other businesses, is an [[term:other-affiliated-company|other affiliated company]] that owns 16.06% of the company's voting rights (including 0.14% held indirectly).

entries.b1987bcd7dba21e1: This business develops, leases, operates and sells renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities, and also manages real estate funds and REITs and invests in overseas real estate development. Power generation facilities and logistics facilities are handled by Tokyu Land Corporation and others, and management of some renewable energy facilities is handled by Renewable Japan Co., Ltd. (renamed Rie-ne Energy Co., Ltd. effective April 1, 2026). Private fund formation and management is handled by Tokyu Land Capital Management Corporation, REIT asset management by Tokyu Land REIT Management Corporation, and overseas development investment by PT.Tokyu Land Indonesia and Tokyu Land US Corporation, among others. The renewable energy business operates under the brand "ReENE". Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥141,303 million (¥108,952 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), the smallest of the four reportable segments. Revenue rose in the Industry business (logistics facilities, etc.) due to an increase in sales to investors and other sales. Renewable energy facilities in operation totaled 223 at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026, with a rated capacity of 2,077 MW (before conversion to equity share).

entries.d1e223e0e0cf5489: The Urban Development Business involves Tokyu Fudosan and others developing office buildings and commercial facilities and leasing or selling them, and it also handles condominiums and rental housing. The Strategic Investment Business covers the development, operation, and sale of renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities, management of real estate funds and REITs, and investment in real estate development in Indonesia, the United States, and other countries. The Management and Operations Business consists of condominium and building management and renovation work by Tokyu Community and others, operation of hotels, golf courses, and ski resorts by Tokyu Resorts & Stay and others, and operation of senior housing, among others. The Real Estate Distribution Business consists of brokerage, sales agency, and purchase-and-resale by Tokyu Livable and others, and management of rental housing and student housing by Tokyu Housing Lease and others. Results at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 were: vacancy rate of office buildings and commercial facilities 0.7%; condominium units booked 899 (1,006 in the prior year); 223 operating renewable energy facilities with a rated capacity of 2,077 MW (before conversion to equity share); managed properties of 832,310 condominium units and 1,420 buildings and other properties; 151 thousand rental housing units under management; and 33,922 brokerage transactions handled. In March 2026, the first data center project operated solely on renewable energy generated by the group was completed in Ishikari, Hokkaido.

entries.e4c538021d3dec16: Leased offices improved in occupancy, centered on the Shibuya area, and tenant sales at both central urban and suburban facilities exceeded the previous fiscal year's levels. Condominiums have solid demand centered on central urban areas, and sales are firm, mainly to end users. At the start of the fiscal year, the proportion contracted against the full-year revenue forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 was 76%. Developed properties are also sold to investors, and fluctuations in these sales affect the revenue of the Urban Development and Strategic Investment businesses. In the Real Estate Distribution Business, in addition to the retail division for individuals, the wholesale division, which captures corporate asset-sale needs, has been growing its transaction volume. Hotels, mainly Tokyu Stay, are performing well with inbound (foreign visitor) stays. Membership resort hotels provide services for members of Tokyu Harvest Club.

entries.f79f9620bf0693b3: This business carries out comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings, operates hotels, golf courses, ski resorts and senior housing, sells membership resort hotels and similar products, and carries out environmental greening. Comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings is carried out by Tokyu Community Corp. and others. Sales agency for membership resort hotels and similar products is carried out by Tokyu Resort Corp. Operation of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts is carried out by Tokyu Resorts & Stay Co., Ltd. Operation and management of senior housing is carried out by Tokyu E-Life Design Co., Ltd. Environmental greening and landscaping are carried out by Sekisho Exterior Co., Ltd. New businesses under the in-house venture system are also included in this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,587 million (¥351,524 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the third largest of the four reportable segments. Management revenue increased due to stable fixed income and an increase in renovation work. However, wellness revenue decreased due to the transition of Ewell Co., Ltd. to an equity-method affiliate following the partial sale of its shares, and the business as a whole declined slightly. The number of managed properties at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 832,310 condominium units and 1,420 buildings and similar properties.
